title: 第11章 饿死胆小的 撑死胆大的

content_zh:
江枫大怒，面对苏景那满脸无辜的神色，他怒喝道：“我什么地方亏待了你，你要这么对待我！江琴……你为什么……”
挣扎着想要去杀苏景，却直接被他信手一推，直接狼狈的摔在了地上！
“你是我的公子，这便是我对待你的理由！”
苏景脸上神色同样转为阴狠，喝道：“只要你活着一天，我就只能是你的奴仆……而只有你死了，我才能真正的活着！”
他高声道：“实话告诉你吧，你贩卖家产的事情都是我经手的，十二星相为什么会知道，你就没有怀疑过吗？是我把消息告诉他们的啊，现在……你什么都知道了，感觉怎么样？！”
“江琴，你耍我！！！”
燕南天眼皮一阵急剧的跳动，怒喝道：“你刚刚跟我说的，你跟我说那个贱婢明明是蛊惑我二弟之人，为何现在又……”
“现在又跟刚才的话完全都不对了？”
苏景哈哈大笑起来，“自然是因为我是在骗你了，蠢货，我就是要看你亲手杀了你二弟的妻子和儿子，偏偏却又是为了救他，公子……你究竟要不要责怪大爷呢？他毕竟也是不知者不怪吧？你兄弟二人感情深厚，区区一个女人，自然不会破坏你们之间的感情，我说的对吧？”
江枫：“………………………………”
他呆呆的看着苏景那熟悉的面孔，眼底浮现一抹恐惧神色，喃喃道：“你……你……”
世上怎会有如此残忍之人？
苏宁眼底一转，浮现一抹坚决之意，喝道：“可惜，我虽然想让你继续痛苦纠结下去，但只是看你活着就让人生气，所以……你还是去死吧!”
他直接从袖中握出一把碧绿短剑！
剑刃散发着碧绿之光，向着江枫的喉咙刺去！
“死吧江枫！！！”
苏景高喊道。
“江琴，你敢！！！”
燕南天愤怒大喝，向着苏景冲去，但他之前为了对付花月奴，似乎是心中实在有愧，因此不敢距离江枫太近，如今再救，却又哪里来的及？
眼见苏景手中碧血照丹青便要刺破江枫的喉咙！

江枫已无反抗能力，脸上露出苦楚神色，罢了，既然月奴已死，那自己又何必再活？
他闭上了眼睛，一心待死！
眼见连燕南天都救之不及……燕南天脸上露出了惊恐神色，心道难道自己真的被这个江琴给骗了？
之前商量好的计划，可没有这一段……而他看样子，分明便是认真的。
到如今，自己的二弟分明便已经在生死之间！
他还未来得及想太多，突然……
一声如夜莺凄厉的叫声喝道：“谁许你杀死江枫的？！”
一道纯白的身影以绝快的速度冲到了苏景与江枫两人中间相隔的地方，一把握住了那把碧血照丹青！
嫩白的手腕顿时鲜血淋漓！
但苏景，却也被她直接辖制住，再也动弹不得！
她喝道：“江琴！我什么时候允许你伤害江枫了？我不许他死……我要他永远在这种折磨下，愧疚的度过一生，死了，不就解脱了？！”
邀月脸上神色狰狞乖张，但眼底，却带着连她自己都迷茫的困惑之意。
为什么要出来？
明明恨不得把那个负心人碎尸万段以泄自己心头之恨，但当看到他真的性命垂危，自己竟然仍然不由自主的跑了出来……是因为花月奴已死，自己又有了希望吗？
还是说……真的就像自己说的那样！
想要折磨他？
“邀……邀月。”
江枫脸上浮现恐惧神色，没想到自己竟然会在这时候见到她！
那神色，让邀月一阵心痛，心爱的男人竟然恐惧自己，没有什么比这更让人失落的了。
“邀月！！！”

眼间燕南天冲了出来，爆喝一声，道：“邀月，你移花宫毫无人性，害我二弟，给我去死吧！”
“我何时害了你的二弟了？”
邀月冷笑道：“明明是你亲手打死了你的弟媳，哦，还有她腹中的孩子……那可是你二弟的亲骨肉，江枫，你不是说你爱花月奴至深，甘愿为她而死吗？如今她死了，你却连为她报仇都做不到？”
“妖女!休得惑我二弟心神，待我杀了你，自然会为二弟恕罪！”
燕南天愤怒高喝一声，拔出了自己那把破剑，向着邀月冲去！
“江琴，给我滚远点！”
邀月看了苏景一眼，有心立即便杀了他，但眼下强敌已至，实在没有闲暇，再加上……若留着他，让江枫看到这个背叛了他的人活的好好的，一定可以让他更为痛苦吧？

content_en:
Jiang Feng was furious. Facing Su Jing's innocent look, he shouted angrily: "I have wronged you in some way, and you want to treat me like this! Jiang Qin... why are you..."
He struggled to kill Su Jing, but was pushed by him and fell to the ground in a panic!
"You are my son, this is why I treat you!"
The expression on Su Jing's face also turned sinister, and he shouted: "As long as you live for one day, I can only be your slave... and only when you die can I truly live!"
He said loudly: "To tell you the truth, I was the one who handled your property sales. Why did the twelve zodiac signs know about it? Didn't you ever doubt it? I told them the news. Now...you know everything. How do you feel?!"
"Jiang Qin, you are kidding me!!!"
Yan Nantian's eyelids twitched sharply, and he shouted angrily: "What you just told me, you told me that that cheap maid was obviously the one who seduced my second brother, why now..."
"Now what you just said is completely wrong again?"
Su Jing burst out laughing, "Of course it's because I'm lying to you, idiot. I just wanted to see you kill your second brother's wife and son with your own hands, but you did it to save him. Young Master... Do you want to blame the uncle? After all, he is the one who doesn't know, right? The two of your brothers have a deep relationship, and a mere woman will naturally not destroy the relationship between you. Am I right?"
Jiang Feng: "………………………………"
He stared blankly at Su Jing's familiar face, with a look of fear in his eyes, and murmured: "You...you..."
How could there be such a cruel person in the world?
Suning's eyes turned, a hint of determination appeared, and he shouted: "Unfortunately, although I want you to continue to suffer and struggle, just seeing you alive makes people angry, so... you should just die!"
He directly took out a green dagger from his sleeve!
The sword blade emitted green light and stabbed towards Jiang Feng's throat!
"Die Jiang Feng!!!"
Su Jinggao shouted.
"Jiang Qin, how dare you!!!"
Yan Nantian shouted angrily and rushed towards Su Jing, but he seemed to feel guilty for dealing with Hua Yuenu before, so he did not dare to get too close to Jiang Feng. Now he would not be able to save him in time.
Seeing the blue blood shining in Su Jing's hand, he was about to pierce Jiang Feng's throat!
Jiang Feng had no ability to resist, and there was a look of pain on his face. That's all, since Yue Slave is dead, why should he live again?
He closed his eyes and wanted to die!
Seeing that even Yan Nantian couldn't save him... Yan Nantian had a look of horror on his face, wondering if he had really been deceived by this Jiang Qin?
The plan that was discussed before did not include this part... and it seemed that he was serious about it.
By now, his second brother is clearly between life and death!
Before he could think too much, suddenly...
A scream as shrill as a nightingale shouted: "Who allowed you to kill Jiang Feng?!"
A pure white figure rushed to the place between Su Jing and Jiang Feng at an extremely fast speed, and grabbed the green blood-shine painting!
The white wrist suddenly dripped with blood!
But Su Jing was also directly controlled by her and could no longer move!
She shouted: "Jiang Qin! When did I allow you to hurt Jiang Feng? I don't allow him to die... I want him to spend his life under this torture forever, feeling guilty. If he dies, won't he be free?!"
Yaoyue's face looked ferocious and perverse, but in her eyes, there was a confusion that even confused her.
Why come out?
Obviously she wanted to cut the unfaithful person into pieces to vent her hatred, but when she saw that his life was really in danger, she still ran out involuntarily... Was it because Huayue Slave was dead and she had hope again?
Or...it's really like what I said!
Want to torture him?
"invite……Yaoyue. "
A look of fear appeared on Jiang Feng's face. He didn't expect to see her at this time!
That look made Yao Yue feel heartbroken. The man she loved was actually afraid of her. There was nothing more disappointing than this.
“Yao Yue! ! ! "
In the blink of an eye, Yan Nantian rushed out, shouted loudly, and said: "Yao Yue, you Yihua Palace is inhumane and you harmed my second brother, so go to hell! "
"When did I harm your second brother? "
Yao Yue sneered and said, "You obviously beat your sister-in-law to death with your own hands, and the child in her belly... that is your second brother's flesh and blood. Jiang Feng, didn't you say that you loved Hua Yuenu so much that you were willing to die for her? Now that she is dead, you can't even avenge her? "
"Witch! Don't confuse my second brother's mind. When I kill you, I will naturally forgive my second brother! "
Yan Nantian shouted angrily, pulled out his broken sword, and rushed towards Yao Yue!
"Jiang Qin, get away from me! "
Yao Yue glanced at Su Jing and wanted to kill him immediately, but now that a powerful enemy had arrived, she really had no time to spare. Plus...if she kept him and let Jiang Feng see that the person who betrayed him was alive and well, it would surely make him suffer even more, right?
